leader.name: Artie Ficial
leader.reason: Provisional tie-break among several very weak suspicions: his anticipatory cover joke stands out. No guest is meaningfully established as the culprit.

naturalism_issues: Every speaker explicitly introduces their own name and nearly everyone follows with a polished occupational one-liner; this works as party character cards but sounds artificial as spontaneous dialogue.
Several introductions advertise convenient future conflicts or secrets. Artie's immersive-experience remark is particularly conspicuous foreshadowing.
No incident or murder evidence has yet been presented, so there is no basis for a substantive culprit ranking.
